SharedScene.title: SharedScene
SharedScene.description: Immutable snapshot of the 3D apartment scene configuration, edited object transforms/visibility, and camera poses shared via a short URL parameter (?s=<shareId>). Contains zero PII.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the shared snapshot was created.

state.description: Persisted 3D scene settings, finishes, furniture configuration, and object edits map.

camera.description: Saved Orbit and Walk camera poses for restoring the exact viewpoint.

CustomCatalogItem.title: CustomCatalogItem
CustomCatalogItem.description: User-submitted interior catalog item with reference photos, free-text dimensions/notes, and AI-analyzed 3D PBR & procedural shape recipe.

title.description: Display name of the furniture item.

photos.description: 1 to 4 compressed reference JPEG/PNG/WebP data URLs.

status.description: Synchronization status with Gemini Vision analysis.

spec.description: AI-analyzed PBR palette, dimensionsM [W,H,D], and structured 3D procedural shape blueprint.

refinementNotes.description: Optional user feedback and correction instructions used when regenerating the 3D model.

/sharedScenes/{shareId}.description: Publicly readable (by exact unguessable ID only), immutable shared 3D apartment scene snapshots. Listing, updating, and deleting are strictly forbidden.

/customCatalogItems/{itemId}.description: Shared interior furniture catalog items synced with Gemini Vision for instant 3D replacement.
